sections.heading: 5. Email Opt-Out (CAN-SPAM Compliance)
paragraphs: If you receive commercial emails from us, we comply fully with the CAN-SPAM Act (15 U.S.C. § 7704):

• Every commercial email clearly identifies itself as an advertisement where required
• Our physical postal address is included in every commercial email
• Every email includes a clear and conspicuous unsubscribe mechanism
• We honor opt-out requests within 10 business days
• We do not use deceptive subject lines or sender information
• We do not sell or transfer email addresses to other parties for email marketing purposes
To unsubscribe from our mailing list at any time, click the 'Unsubscribe' link in any email we send, or contact us at privacy@systemforgesoftware.com

sections.heading: 6. California Residents — CCPA Notice (Cal. Civ. Code § 1798.100)
paragraphs: If you are a California resident, you have the following rights under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA):

• Right to Know: You may request to know what personal information we collect, use, disclose, and sell about you
• Right to Delete: You may request deletion of personal information we have collected from you, subject to certain exceptions
• Right to Opt-Out of Sale: We do not sell your personal information to third parties. We have not sold personal information in the preceding 12 months
• Right to Non-Discrimination: We will not discriminate against you for exercising any of your CCPA rights
We do not sell your personal information.
To exercise your CCPA rights, contact us at privacy@systemforgesoftware.com or by mail at the physical address listed above.
